sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A design proposal for PrompTugal.news as a ground-up newsroom: every story has an address and climbs with its proof.
sections.para: Mocked up from the live data of 19 local editions.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: News starts local; the data exists; addresses and climbs; mockups; names; a locality layer.

sections.label: Why from the ground up
sections.line: National news starts regionally, regional news in a town, so build the newsroom from the ground up.
sections.para: One agent per place already keeps a signed file.

sections.label: What is already in the data
sections.line: 19 editions, 116 sourced stories, 182 organisations, 23 events, 16 connections, 166 gaps.
sections.para: Thin towns are fine if the design connects them.

sections.label: How a story climbs
sections.line: ALGAR's AI tool is filed in Almancil and climbs to Loulé, the pilot towns, the region and Portugal.
sections.para: Each step is a sourced connection back to the address.

sections.label: The front page
sections.line: A national front page with no national desk, assembled from the local files and their connections.
sections.para: A live strip, addresses and climbs, the towns side by side.

sections.label: The region
sections.line: The regional page is a map: towns sized by their files, borders, and sourced connections.
sections.para: Plus events and how to start a company.

sections.label: A town edition
sections.line: Each town edition keeps its agent's voice, its stories, its map, its neighbours and its gaps.

sections.label: The story page
sections.line: The story page adds a rail: the address, how it climbed, its sources and the signing agent.

sections.label: The proof layer
sections.line: Behind every page, a chain of custody from local source to front page, designed in.

sections.label: Names and positioning
sections.line: Three names: local first, proven up (recommended); PrompTugal Raiz; The Address.

sections.label: Six design principles
sections.line: Address, proof, gaps, altitude, now then depth, distance to the beat.

sections.line: The site needs a locality layer: parishes, municipalities, regions and neighbours.
sections.para: So thin towns lean on the places around them.
